- **Talk & My Life (tease)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]

## The recordings

- **Ween1999-07-23** (recommended): source not stated; 44 songs; 279 min [1]
- **ween1999-07-23.flacf**: audience recording; 29 songs; 171 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the audience recording's audio quality very nice [4]
- **ween1999-07-23.HG.master**: source not stated; 27 songs; 206 min [3]

## Around the show

- Uploader recalls the show being taped by the WeenRadio.com operator, who streamed it live online; unsure this is that tape [1]
- Reviewer calls the setlist fairly standard and says a second encore would have improved the show [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **Ween1999-07-23**: Lineage given as unknown audience source, possibly minidisc, then CDR, EAC, and FLAC [1]
- **ween1999-07-23.flacf**: transferred by ringo; source: AUD>DAT [2]. Also: This copy seems to come from the WeenRadio.com live stream of the show; A cleaner, probably pre-stream version exists that also includes the soundcheck, posted separately on the Internet Archive; The venue later released its own archival master, captured by Neumann microphones hung from the ceiling in a sweet spot [5]
- **ween1999-07-23.HG.master**: taped by unknown; source: Neumann KM184 (20’ from the stage, DFC, hanging from the rafters) > Sony PCM R500 > DAT [3]
